localDoulas.name: Kirby Paddock
localDoulas.description:
Birth doula serving Montgomery and surrounding counties in Texas.

Certified babywearing consultant included in birth packages. Specializes in high-risk hospital births with 2 prenatal visits, full labor support, and 1 postpartum visit.

localDoulas.name: Shelbie Cunningham
localDoulas.description:
Full-spectrum birth and postpartum doula certified through Doula Training International.

Offers customizable birth packages, postpartum care, family planning support, and bereavement doula services. Mom of 3 who brings personal experience to every birth.

localDoulas.name: Lizet Ansaldo
localDoulas.description:
Bilingual (English/Spanish) birth doula serving Conroe and Willis.

Full package includes birth plan creation, childbirth education class, prenatal visits, labor support, breastfeeding assistance, and postpartum visit. Total cost $1,500 with $200 childbirth ed add-on.

culture:
Conroe is the seat of Montgomery County and the gateway to Lake Conroe, sitting about 40 minutes north of Houston on I-45.

The city has grown fast alongside The Woodlands, and HCA Houston Healthcare Conroe is the only hospital with labor and delivery in Montgomery County. The downtown Conroe birth center gives families an out-of-hospital option that most neighboring counties lack. The mix of long-time Conroe residents and Houston transplants means you’ll find both hospital-first and birth-center preferences in the same community.
heroLocalDetail: HCA Houston Healthcare Conroe sits at 504 Medical Drive, just off I-45 North at the Loop 336 exit. If you’re coming from The Woodlands or Spring, take I-45 North to Exit 87 (Loop 336 West) and follow the hospital signs. The birth center is at 1202 N San Jacinto St, about 5 minutes from the hospital in downtown Conroe.

hospitalDetails.name: HCA Houston Healthcare Conroe
hospitalDetails.waterBirth: Hydrotherapy available; water birth varies by provider
hospitalDetails.paragraph: HCA Houston Healthcare Conroe, at 504 Medical Drive, is the only hospital with labor and delivery in Montgomery County. The hospital offers private birthing suites, 24/7 obstetric hospitalists, and lactation support. Contact the hospital directly for current NICU level verification, as the NICU designation was not confirmed on the hospital’s website at last check. They handle a high volume of births for the Conroe–The Woodlands corridor, so come with your preferences written down — a birth plan helps the team work with you when things move fast. Use our free hospital birth plan template to get started.

birthCenterDetails.name: Journey Birth Center
birthCenterDetails.paragraph: Journey Birth Center, at 1202 N San Jacinto St in downtown Conroe, is a freestanding birth center offering low-intervention, midwife-led births in a home-like setting. They serve families from Conroe, The Woodlands, and Montgomery County who want an alternative to hospital birth. Verify with the center directly for current services and insurance coverage.

birthCenterDetails.name: Bliss Women’s Wellness & Birth Center
birthCenterDetails.paragraph: Bliss Women’s Wellness & Birth Center, at 14157 Horseshoe Bend in Conroe (NPI 1457935439), is an NPI-verified freestanding birth center offering midwife-led birth and women’s wellness services. Verify with the center directly for current services, insurance coverage, and availability.

birthCenterDetails.name: Nativiti Family Birth Center
birthCenterDetails.paragraph: Nativiti Family Birth Center, at 26614 Oak Ridge Dr in The Woodlands (NPI 1245638287), is an NPI-verified freestanding birth center about 15 minutes south of Conroe. They offer CNM-led births and serve the broader Montgomery County area. Verify with the center directly for current services and insurance coverage.

medicaidNote: No — Texas does not yet have statewide Medicaid doula coverage as of May 2026. Some health plans and managed-care organizations may offer doula benefits; check with your plan for current coverage details.
insuranceNote:
HCA Houston Healthcare Conroe accepts most major private insurance plans.

Some insurers in the Montgomery County area offer maternal wellness benefits that partially cover doula services — check with your provider directly, and ask whether HSA or FSA funds can help with out-of-pocket costs.

faqs.q: How much does a doula cost in Conroe?
faqs.a: Expect to pay $1,500 to $5,000. Can't swing the full price? Ask about sliding-scale options. most doulas would rather work with your budget than see you go without. The investment typically covers prenatal visits, labor support, and postpartum check-ins. Grab the free birth plan template and start thinking about what matters most to you.

faqs.q: Does Medicaid cover doulas in Conroe?
faqs.a: Not yet. Texas does not have statewide Medicaid doula coverage as of May 2026. Some health plans (like BCBS TX Special Beginning, Dell Children's) offer limited doula benefits. That includes Montgomery County’s STAR managed care plans. Here's your next step: call your Medicaid plan and ask "Do you cover doula services?". they'll walk you through it, or call 1-877-543-7669 directly. You can also check online at YourTexasBenefits.com. You deserve support, and some plans are starting to help pay for it.

faqs.q: Which hospitals in Conroe have labor and delivery?
faqs.a: HCA Houston Healthcare Conroe, at 504 Medical Drive, is the only hospital with labor and delivery in Montgomery County. Contact the hospital directly for current NICU level verification. The birth center at 1202 N San Jacinto St offers midwife-led out-of-hospital birth for low-risk pregnancies. Grab the free birth plan template so you walk in knowing exactly what you want.

faqs.q: Does True Joy Birthing work for Conroe families?
faqs.a: Yes. and it's free. True Joy Birthing's birth plan app, checklist, and guided walkthrough work for any Conroe birth setting, whether you're delivering at a hospital, a birth center, or at home. The app also helps you find and connect with local doulas and midwives. Download Your Birth Plan template and start preparing your way. no signup required.

midwifeInfo.paragraph: Texas licenses Certified Nurse-Midwives (CNMs) through the Texas Board of Nursing, and they practice at hospitals and birth centers across the Houston–Conroe corridor, including nearby facilities in The Woodlands and Huntsville. Texas also licenses Certified Professional Midwives (CPMs) through the Texas Department of State Health Services, so families in Conroe can choose licensed out-of-hospital birth care at area birth centers or at home with a licensed CPM.
